Author: Coasted-create
Name: Mod Closet 2
Punchline: Your Penumbra mods as a closet: pick a piece, click a mod, it is on.
Description: Sorts your Penumbra mods onto shelves by what they are on you (tops, ears, tails, nails…). Click a card to try it on over your look, Keep to make it stay, Put back to undo the try. Drag a mod to another shelf and the closet remembers. Every card shows a photo of its piece, taken by the closet itself without touching your character. Outfit colours for what you wear, looks that save themselves, and On you: point at a part of your character to change it. Requires Penumbra and Glamourer. Command: /closet2
